title: FAMAS stresses Maricel Soriano, Maris Racal awards recognize different acting achievements

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Filipino Academy of Movie Arts and Sciences (FAMAS) has clarified the distinction between Maricel Soriano’s Best Actress win and Maris Racal’s Actress of Distinction honor at its 74th awards ceremony, emphasizing that the two recognitions are not in competition with each other. In a statement, FAMAS clarified that Soriano’s award for “Meet, Greet, and Bye” and Racal’s recognition for “Sunshine” celebrate different aspects of acting excellence rather than establish a hierarchy between the two actresses.
